title: Hackers Sell Corporate VPN, RDP, and Cloud Access Through Underground Forums
content_md: Threat actors are advertising corporate VPN accounts, remote desktop connections, cloud credentials, and authenticated business application sessions across underground forums, offering buyers potential footholds for data theft, fraud, espionage, and ransomware. Advertised prices ranged from $250 for an alleged PandaDoc session to $4,000 for manufacturing-sector remote access.
